name: Habitat
description: Habitat workshop and offline library: scientific Python, licensed references and data, procedural images/audio/animation and sandboxed FFmpeg composition.
notes: S020b adds bounded library.search/read over immutable licensed text/CSV assets and a new operator-provisioned image containing FFmpeg/ffprobe. All 25 capabilities remain container-tier and network/GPU-free; older image/world versions are unchanged. Media is generated/edited by Python programs using installed FFmpeg, never by hosted or local AI in this slice. Existing explicit experiment grants and data-only lineage remain authoritative.
